note: Single source of truth for directory-exclusion scope across gates.
Consumed by guardrails-scan.mjs, semantic-scan.mjs, and the
silent-success scan. Projects EXTEND via the .guardrails overlay,
never by editing the submodule baseline (overlay-not-fork).
Note: 'pkg' is deliberately NOT excluded — it is commonly first-party Go source; the module cache lives outside the repo (and .sandbox-home covers the reported divergence case).
